description.p: ShimeLinux is a Linux port of Shimeji-ee desktop pet, an application which lets you have little characters (called Shimeji) walking around on your desktop.

ul.li: It supports desktop environments using X11, like Cinnamon and XFCE, and Wayland, like KDE Plasma and GNOME
It also works on tiling window managers, like Hyprland, niri, and sway
It is compatible with any Shimeji made for the latest version of Shimeji-ee

screenshot.caption: A couple of Shimeji are climbing on the ShimeLinux settings window.
The Shimeji image set chooser is open while a bunch of Shimeji climb along the edges of the screen.
